readme:
Tanzu Portal Builder plugin interface for this [backstage gitlab plugin](https://github.com/loblaw-sre/backstage-plugin-gitlab).

## Branches

There are two maintained branches. All working MRs should target the `main` branch. Whenever we want to publish a new version, we should merge changes from `main` into the `releases` branch.
A pipeline watching the `releases` branch will automatically publish this new plugin version to Artifactory and also update the plugin version in the `package.json`file in both branches.

## Publishing Steps

1. `yarn changeset` and commit changes
2. Push changes + create an MR targetting `main`
3. Merge `main` into `releases` branch
4. Observe the pipeline for green builds
